blockers: An element is wider than its container.
fixes: Show a pressed or selected state at once, and confirm the result near the control.
Make actions look clickable with a button shape, an icon, or a link color. Keep static text plain.
Same name repeated across regions: Show each name once in each region, and remove copies that add nothing.
Give the control a visible pressed or selected state.
Set code, commands, IDs, and paths in one monospace font.
Give icons, input borders, and focus rings at least 3:1 contrast.
